short.prompt: What are the developments and trends that can impact on professional practice?
short.modelAnswer:
TVET is undergoing enormous change. Teachers must keep updating their technical skills. Developments and trends may include:
1. New/revised Training Packages in your technical and vocational area
2. Regulatory changes in vocational area of competency
3. New developments/directions/trends in vocational education and training
4. Policy changes in vocational education and training

keyPoints.text: Some changes will bring a very different role for the TVET teacher/trainer.

cites.quote: Some of these are fundamental changes that will eventually see
